### CVE-2008-0298
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2008-01-16 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 31021: Apple Safari 2.0.4 - KHTML WebKit Remote Denial of Service (dos/osx, 2008-01-12, verified=1)

KHTML WebKit as used in Apple Safari 2.x allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (browser crash) via a crafted web page, possibly involving a STYLE attribute of a DIV element.

### CVE-2008-5821
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2009-01-02 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 32694: Apple Safari 3.2 WebKit - 'alink' Property Memory Leak Remote Denial of Service (1) (dos/osx, 2009-01-01, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 32695: Apple Safari 3.2 WebKit - 'alink' Property Memory Leak Remote Denial of Service (2) (dos/osx, 2009-01-01, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 12408: Apple Safari 4.0.5 (531.22.7) - Denial of Service (dos/windows, 2010-04-26, verified=1)

Memory leak in WebKit.dll in WebKit, as used by Apple Safari 3.2 on Windows Vista SP1, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory consumption and browser crash) via a long ALINK attribute in a BODY element in an HTML document.
